jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: Join our flagship core engineering team building scalable microservices and lightning-fast web applications. You will collaborate with product designers, architect cloud components, and ship mission-critical code to millions of end-users worldwide.
responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable front-end & back-end code
Integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic and cloud databases
Participate in sprint planning, code reviews, and architecture discussions
Optimize applications for maximum speed, security, and scalability
jobs.qualifications: B.Tech / B.E. in CSE, IT, or allied computing disciplines with minimum 65% aggregate.

jobs.title: Machine Learning & NLP Engineer
jobs.description: Develop next-generation generative AI solutions and natural language understanding models. We are seeking talented engineers who understand transformer architectures, fine-tuning, and scalable inference deployment.
responsibilities: Research, train, and deploy transformer-based LLMs and computer vision models
Fine-tune multimodal models on domain-specific corpora using PyTorch
Build high-throughput inference endpoints with ONNX / TensorRT
Conduct benchmark experiments and publish empirical performance reports
jobs.qualifications: B.Tech / M.Tech in AI/ML, AI/DS, or CSE with strong foundational coursework in linear algebra and deep learning.

jobs.title: Embedded Systems & IoT Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: SiliconSense is pioneering industrial smart meters and connected automotive sensors. We are hiring proactive embedded developers to write low-level firmware, configure communication protocols (CAN, SPI, I2C), and optimize RTOS task execution.
responsibilities: Write efficient C/C++ firmware for ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers and RISC-V targets
Interface hardware peripherals: SPI, I2C, UART, ADC, and BLE/Zigbee radio modules
Debug boards using digital oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG emulators
Perform static analysis, memory profiling, and MISRA-C compliance checks
jobs.qualifications: B.Tech in Electronics & Communication or Electrical Engineering with solid understanding of microcontrollers.

jobs.title: Mechanical Design & CAE Simulation Engineer
jobs.description: Contribute to lightweight chassis design, structural stress evaluations, and aerodynamic simulations for electric vehicle systems. Hands-on experience with parametric CAD and FEA tools is strongly required.
responsibilities: Generate detailed 3D CAD assemblies and 2D fabrication drawings in SolidWorks / CATIA
Perform structural, modal, and thermal simulations in ANSYS Workbench
Coordinate with toolmakers and stamping suppliers for DFM / DFA optimization
Analyze prototype failure modes and execute mechanical testing rigs
jobs.qualifications: B.Tech / B.E. in Mechanical Engineering with certified CAD/CAE coursework or project portfolio.

jobs.title: Structural BIM & Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Lead digital structural modeling and coordination for urban metro viaducts and smart transit terminals. Collaborate with structural architects, MEP engineers, and site coordinators using modern BIM standards.
responsibilities: Develop parametric 3D structural models in Autodesk Revit and Navisworks
Conduct structural analysis and load calculation according to IS / Eurocodes
Perform clash detection between structural elements and MEP conduits
Prepare bar bending schedules (BBS) and structural shop drawings
jobs.qualifications: B.Tech in Civil Engineering with strong proficiency in STAAD.Pro and Revit.

jobs.title: Process Automation & Control Engineer
jobs.description: Support continuous refinery optimization, chemical reactor control loops, and environmental compliance systems. Excellent exposure to P&ID diagrams, mass-energy balances, and Aspen Plus simulations.
responsibilities: Model continuous distillation columns and kinetic reactor units in Aspen Plus / HYSYS
Design control schematics, safety interlocks, and HAZOP documentation
Monitor operational KPIs and reduce energy footprint across heat exchangers
Collaborate with DCS engineers to tune PID controllers
jobs.qualifications: B.Tech / B.E. in Chemical Engineering or Petrochemical Engineering.

jobs.title: Bioinformatics & Computational Biologist
jobs.description: Harness high-throughput genomic data, single-cell RNA-sequencing pipelines, and protein-ligand docking tools to discover therapeutic molecular targets for autoimmune oncology therapies.
responsibilities: Analyze NGS genomic data, variant calling, and transcriptomic datasets
Execute molecular docking simulations and molecular dynamics trajectories (GROMACS)
Maintain automated bioinformatic workflows using Nextflow and Docker
Coordinate with wet-lab assays to validate target gene candidates
jobs.qualifications: B.Tech / M.Tech in Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, or Computational Life Sciences.

jobs.title: Power Systems & Renewable Energy Specialist
jobs.description: Work on smart microgrids, solar inverter integrations, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and high-voltage grid stability models for national transmission networks.
responsibilities: Simulate grid transients and power flow dynamics using PSCAD / ETAP
Design protection relay schemes and harmonic mitigation filters for solar farms
Perform power quality assessments and grid code compliance verifications
Evaluate battery charging telemetry and energy dispatch algorithms
jobs.qualifications: B.Tech in Electrical & Electronics Engineering with minimum 7.0 CGPA.

jobs.title: Graduate Technical Trainee (Cross-Discipline)
jobs.description: Prestigious fast-track graduate engineer trainee program spanning robotics, embedded controllers, aerospace structures, quality engineering, and digital manufacturing.
responsibilities: Rotate across precision manufacturing, hardware QA, systems engineering, and IT divisions
Solve real-world industrial optimization problems during 6-month modular rotations
Undergo hands-on leadership training and direct executive mentorship
Contribute to ISO-9001 and AS9100 aerospace quality verification
jobs.qualifications: B.Tech / B.E. in ANY engineering discipline with first class or distinction.

internships.title: Frontend React & UI/UX Developer Intern
internships.description: Create ultra-smooth responsive web interfaces, interactive dashboards, and design component libraries using React, TypeScript, and modern CSS. You will collaborate with product designers and senior engineers.
responsibilities: Build modular, accessible UI components in React and CSS
Connect front-end state with REST & GraphQL APIs
Optimize client-side performance, Core Web Vitals, and responsive layouts
Participate in daily standups and weekly design critique sessions

internships.title: Data Science & Predictive Analytics Intern
internships.description: Clean, parse, and analyze multi-terabyte transactional datasets. Build customer churn predictors, time-series forecasting models, and interactive visual reporting dashboards.
responsibilities: Execute exploratory data analysis (EDA) using Pandas, NumPy, and Seaborn
Build and tune gradient boosted decision trees (XGBoost / LightGBM)
Engineer feature pipelines and query relational data with complex SQL
Present actionable data summaries to stakeholders and product leads

internships.title: VLSI Chip Verification & FPGA Intern
internships.description: Step into semiconductor chip development! Write SystemVerilog testbenches, perform UVM verification simulations, and assist in synthesis runs for next-generation RISC-V compute cores.
responsibilities: Design directed and constrained-random testbenches in SystemVerilog
Simulate RTL designs in ModelSim / QuestaSim and debug waveform traces
Verify functional and code coverage metrics against specifications
Assist physical design engineers in timing constraint synthesis

internships.title: Automotive CAD Modeling & Simulation Intern
internships.description: Assist in designing electric scooter suspension linkages, battery pack thermal enclosures, and ergonomic handlebar brackets using CATIA and SolidWorks.
responsibilities: Model 3D parametric components and generate 2D manufacturing drawings
Perform static linear stress evaluations using ANSYS Mechanical
Assist senior prototype engineers during physical drop and vibration testing
Maintain bill of materials (BOM) and revision logs in PDM

internships.title: Civil Site Survey & Smart Construction Intern
internships.description: Hands-on site engineering internship covering digital total station surveys, concrete mix design testing, quality audits, and contractor coordination for high-rise commercial structures.
responsibilities: Assist site project managers in day-to-day quality inspection and concrete cube testing
Review architectural drawings against on-site structural execution
Maintain site measurement books and quantity surveying spreadsheets
Observe safety protocol compliance and draft daily site progress logs

internships.title: Bioprocess & Fermentation R&D Intern
internships.description: Assist in optimizing microbial fermentation runs, media formulation, down-stream protein purification (HPLC, FPLC), and assay quantification for recombinant enzymes.
responsibilities: Prepare microbial culture media, inoculate shake flasks, and monitor optical density
Operate benchtop fermenters and log pH, dissolved oxygen, and agitation levels
Perform SDS-PAGE electrophoresis and Bradford protein quantitation
Maintain GLP laboratory notebooks and follow biosafety standards

internships.title: Cybersecurity Analyst & Threat Hunting Intern
internships.description: Assist our SOC team in analyzing network traffic captures (Wireshark), investigating vulnerability scans, tracking CVE databases, and crafting penetration test reports.
responsibilities: Review SIEM log alerts and identify anomalous network behaviors
Perform basic vulnerability assessments using Nessus and Nmap
Draft threat remediation guidance for engineering teams
Participate in internal capture-the-flag (CTF) security exercises

internships.title: Smart Energy & Battery Management Intern
internships.description: Assist in testing Lithium-ion battery pack telemetry, designing balancing circuits, and writing state-of-charge (SoC) estimation algorithms for solar storage.
responsibilities: Test battery cell charge/discharge curves in temperature-controlled chambers
Simulate cell balancing circuits in MATLAB Simulink and LTSpice
Log thermal telemetry and evaluate passive heat dissipation fins
Assist with assembly of test prototype BMS boards
